title: RePlan-VLA: Progress-Aware Replanning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet their performance often degrades on long-horizon tasks that require multiple interdependent manipulations. Instead of burdening the VLA policies with long-horizon reasoning, memory, action generation, progress tracking, and error recovery, we argue for leveraging their short-horizon manipulation capabilities within an execution-aware framework. To this end, we introduce \textnormal{\textbf{RePlan-VLA}}, a VLA-agnostic framework that translates a VLA's short-horizon capabilities into reliable long-horizon execution. RePlan-VLA explicitly monitors the robot's motion for progress evaluation, and adaptively revises the future plan based on observed outcomes. translated_title: RePlan-VLA：面向长时程视觉-语言-动作模型的进度感知重规划
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用机器人操作的一种有前景的范式，但它们在需要多次相互依赖操作的长时程任务上性能往往会下降。我们没有让VLA策略承担长时程推理、记忆、动作生成、进度跟踪和错误恢复等负担，而是主张在一个执行感知框架中利用它们的短时程操作能力。为此，我们提出了RePlan-VLA，这是一个与具体VLA模型无关的框架，能够将VLA的短时程能力转化为可靠的长时程执行。RePlan-VLA通过显式监测机器人的运动来评估任务进度，并根据观察到的结果自适应地修订未来计划。我们完全保留了底层VLA策略，无需任何额外的微调。在RoboCasa365和CALVIN基准上的实验显示，性能分别提升了21.9%和……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RePlan-VLA是一个与具体VLA模型无关的框架，通过监测机器人运动来评估任务进度并自适应地修订未来计划，从而将VLA模型的短时程操作能力转化为可靠的长时程任务执行能力，且完全无需对底层VLA策略进行额外微调。
en_tdlr: RePlan-VLA is a VLA-agnostic framework that monitors robot motion for progress evaluation and adaptively revises future plans, translating VLA models' short-horizon manipulation capabilities into reliable long-horizon execution without any additional fine-tuning of the underlying VLA policy.
